findings.title: Missing `key` prop on `GrafanaRuleListItem` inside list `.map()`
findings.body: In `FilterViewResults`, when replacing `<GrafanaRuleLoader key={key} ... />` with `<GrafanaRuleListItem ... />` inside `rules.map(...)`, the `key={key}` prop was dropped. `key` is still destructured from `ruleWithOrigin` on line 152, and not passing it to `<GrafanaRuleListItem>` causes a React missing-key warning and can lead to incorrect component reconciliation when the filtered rule list updates.

findings.title: Silence notifications menu item does nothing in the alert list view when `rulerRule` is omitted
findings.body: In the new list view (`GrafanaRuleListItem`), `RuleActionsButtons` is rendered with only `promRule` and `rule` (`rulerRule`) is `undefined`. `AlertRuleMenu` now uses `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` on `promRule` to compute `canSilence`, so the "Silence notifications" menu item is displayed and clicking it sets `showSilenceDrawer` to `true`. However, `RuleActionsButtons` still gates rendering `<SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer>` on `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` (line 104), which is `false` when `rule` is `undefined`. As a result, clicking "Silence notifications" on a Grafana rule in the alert list view silently does nothing.

findings.title: Pause and Delete menu items are hidden for Grafana rules in the alert list view
findings.body: `AlertRuleMenu` was updated to compute `canPause` and `canDelete` from `promRule` via `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` when `rulerRule` is not provided (as in `GrafanaRuleListItem`). However, the JSX conditions rendering the menu items still require `rulerRule` to be defined: line 123 checks `canPause && rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule) && ...` and line 165 checks `canDelete && rulerRule`. Because `GrafanaRuleListItem` only passes `promRule` (and not `rule`/`rulerRule`) to `RuleActionsButtons`, both the Pause and Delete actions are completely missing from the "More" menu for Grafana-managed rules in the list view.

findings.title: `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` disallows Pause, Restore, and ModifyExport on Grafana recording rules
findings.body: In `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, `Pause`, `Restore`, `DeletePermanently`, and `ModifyExport` are supported for all Grafana-managed rules (`rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rule)`, which includes both alerting and recording rules). In `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`, those actions are gated on `isAlertingRule` (`prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)`), which is `false` for `GrafanaPromRecordingRuleDTO`. Consequently, Grafana-managed recording rules lose `Pause`, `Restore`, `DeletePermanently`, and `ModifyExport` abilities when evaluated via `GrafanaPromRuleDTO`.

findings.title: `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` allows silencing even when `rule` is undefined or folder is still loading
findings.body: In `useCanSilence` (used for `RulerRuleDTO`), silencing returns `[false, false]` if `!rule`, `folderIsLoading`, or `!folder`. In `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`, `useCanSilenceInFolder(rule?.folderUid)` is called directly without checking `loading` or `!folder`: if a user has the global `AlertingInstanceCreate` permission, `canSilenceInFolder` is `true` even while the folder is still loading or failed to load. This causes `AlertRuleAction.Silence` to report `[true, true]` before folder data is available (inconsistent with `useCanSilence`).

findings.title: `returnTo` query parameter dropped from rule view link in `GrafanaRuleListItem`
findings.body: In the removed `GrafanaRuleLoader.tsx`, `GrafanaRuleListItem` constructed the rule view link with `createRelativeUrl(\`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view\`, { returnTo })` using `createReturnTo()`. In the new `GrafanaRuleListItem.tsx` (line 40), `returnTo` is omitted (`createRelativeUrl(\`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view\`)`), so navigating to a Grafana rule from the list or filter view no longer preserves the `returnTo` URL for the "Back" button in the rule viewer.
